definitions.full: H472. Elisheba אֱלִישֶׁ֫בַע proper name, feminine ( God is an oath , by which one swears, compare Isa 19:18 ; Amos 8:14 ; Zeph 1:5 ) wife of Aaron Exod 6:23 ; = Ἐλεισαβεθ ᵐ5 , compare Luke 1:7 .
definitions.rootNote: from 410 and 7651 (in the sense of 7650 ); God of (the) oath;

occurrences.englishText: Aaron took Elisheba, the daughter of Amminadab, the sister of Nahshon, as his wife; and she bore him Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
